`CHANGELOG.md`:

```md
# Changelog

## 2.2.2
- Shorter extension description, to fit the Chrome Web Store's 132-character limit. No changes to the trainer itself

## 2.2.1
- Fixed: the panel clipped and showed a horizontal scrollbar in tall or small windows
- Fixed: Y, I and O now follow the letter on your keyboard, so Y is the key labelled Y on QWERTZ
- Infinite Nitrous can be toggled by clicking its row, for keyboards with no Insert key
- The panel no longer says "Online" before Go Offline, since the game may not be connected; it just says "Car Cheats Locked"
- Safari: partly tested on Safari 27.2 and still experimental, with clearer install steps

## 2.2.0
- Overlay restyled against screenshots of the running game: lime-framed dialog, grey list rows with key cells, pill buttons and a Bank box modelled on the HUD's
- Toasts now use the shape of the game's "now playing" card
- Panel opens in the free space between the minimap and the gauges, at any window size
- New font: Archivo Narrow Italic (SIL OFL 1.1, licence in `fonts-OFL.txt`), embedded because the site's CSP blocks font files
- New icon in the same style, with a simpler drawing for the 16 and 32 px sizes
- Fixed: Set Bank wrote $0 when the field was empty or not a number (Firefox lets you type letters there)
- Fixed: the offline-only gate only counted connected friends, not other players in the shared world. It now also checks that the game has left that world, and the panel's always-zero "Players Around" count is gone
- Firefox is now supported, tested on Firefox 159
- No changes to hotkeys or settings

## 2.1.0
- In-game styled overlay (Underground 2 colours, angled panels, race-style notifications)
- New icon
- Builds for Chromium, Firefox (experimental) and Safari (experimental)

## 2.0.0
- Rebuilt on the memory layout from Racer_S's original NFSU2 +10 Trainer
- Boost, instant 200 mph, super brakes, jump, move forward, infinite nitrous, nitrous refill, position save/warp, speed lock
- Car cheats locked to offline play

## 1.0.1
- Bank editor with the classic 0x861E74 address

```

```md
# Privacy Policy

**U2 Revived Trainer**
Last updated: 7 November 2026

U2 Revived Trainer is an unofficial, fan-made browser extension for the Underground 2 Revived game at nfsu2.xyz. This policy covers the extension only.

## Data we collect

None. The extension doesn't collect, transmit, sell or share any user data, and it has no analytics or tracking. It makes no network requests, so nothing it handles leaves your device.

## What stays on your device

Panel settings, like the boost multiplier, are saved in the page's local storage for nfsu2.xyz on your device, so they're still there next time you play. They're never sent anywhere by the extension. You can remove them by clearing your browser's site data for nfsu2.xyz.

## Site access

The extension runs only on `https://nfsu2.xyz/*` and requests no other permissions. It reads and changes the game's memory in that page to provide the trainer's features.

## Third parties

The extension shares nothing with third parties. nfsu2.xyz is a separate site that the extension's developer doesn't run, so this policy doesn't cover what that site does.

## Changes

Any changes to this policy will be published in this file, with a new date above.

## Contact

Questions can go to the project's issue tracker: https://github.com/rf-dev-design/nfsu2-revived-trainer/issues

```

`README.md`:

```md
<p align="center">
  <img src="icons/icon-128.png" width="96" alt="U2 Revived Trainer icon">
</p>

<h1 align="center">U2 Revived Trainer</h1>

<p align="center">
  <b>The old-school +10 trainer, back for the browser.</b><br>
  Money, 200 mph launches, super brakes, jumps, infinite nitrous and warps for <a href="https://nfsu2.xyz/">Underground 2 Revived</a>, all from an in-game overlay styled like the game itself.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <img alt="Chromium" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Chromium-supported-46c8ff?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white">
  <img alt="Firefox" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Firefox-supported-46c8ff?style=for-the-badge&logo=firefoxbrowser&logoColor=white">
  <img alt="Safari" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Safari-experimental-ff9a1f?style=for-the-badge&logo=safari&logoColor=white">
  <img alt="Manifest V3" src="https://img.shields.io/badge/Manifest-V3-1b2130?style=for-the-badge">
</p>

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Made specifically for Chromium browsers, Firefox and [https://nfsu2.xyz/](https://nfsu2.xyz/).**
> It is built and tested on Chrome-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi) and Firefox, and only runs on the nfsu2.xyz browser remake. It does not work with the original PC game or any other port. The Safari build is experimental and only partly tested.

<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/panel.png" width="720" alt="The trainer panel over the game, styled in Underground 2 colours">
</p>

---

## Why

Underground 2 was the game for a lot of us, and so were the little trainers we ran next to it: one keypress for cash, another to launch the car to 200 mph. The browser remake on nfsu2.xyz brought the game back. This brings the trainer back with it.

It keeps the exact key layout of **Racer_S's NFSU2 +10 Trainer** from the mid-2000s, so your fingers already know where everything is.

## Features

| Key | What it does |
|:---:|---|
| <kbd>Y</kbd> | **Boost**: multiplies your current speed (×2 by default, capped at a max you set) |
| <kbd>I</kbd> | **Instant 200 mph** in the direction you're facing |
| <kbd>PgDn</kbd> | **Super brakes**: stops the car dead, spin included |
| <kbd>End</kbd> | **Jump** (height adjustable) |
| <kbd>PgUp</kbd> | **Move forward** a few metres: pops you straight through red barriers and walls |
| <kbd>Insert</kbd> | **Infinite nitrous** on/off |
| <kbd>Delete</kbd> | **Nitrous refill** |
| <kbd>O</kbd> | **Bank to $99,999,999** |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>9</kbd> | **Save** your position to a slot |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>9</kbd> | **Warp** back to a saved position |
| <kbd>F2</kbd> | Show / hide the trainer panel |

The panel (<kbd>F2</kbd>) adds a **bank editor** (set any amount, optional freeze), a **speed lock** (hold the car at a fixed km/h), and live readouts for your bank and speed.

On a MacBook, use <kbd>Fn</kbd>+<kbd>↓</kbd> for PgDn, <kbd>Fn</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd> for PgUp, <kbd>Fn</kbd>+<kbd>→</kbd> for End, <kbd>Fn</kbd>+<kbd>Delete</kbd> for Delete and, if needed, <kbd>Fn</kbd>+<kbd>F2</kbd> for F2. There's no Insert key, so click the **Infinite Nitrous** row in the panel instead.

<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/toast.png" width="720" alt="In-game style notification after pressing I">
</p>

## Fair play: car cheats are offline-only

nfsu2.xyz has shared free roam and online races with real people. Boosting through a lobby would ruin it for them, so:

- **Car cheats** (everything except money) only work after you press **Go offline** in the panel, and they lock again if the game reconnects to the shared world or a friend connects.
- **Money** works any time, since your bank only affects your own career.
- When the cheats are off, their keys pass straight through to the game, so nothing interferes with normal play.

## Install

Grab the package for your browser from the [**Releases**](../../releases) page.

### Chromium (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi): recommended

1. Download `u2-revived-trainer-chromium-vX.Y.Z.zip` and unzip it into a folder you'll keep.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (or `edge://extensions`) and switch on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the folder.
4. Open [nfsu2.xyz](https://nfsu2.xyz/), start the game, and press <kbd>F2</kbd>.

### Firefox

1. Download `u2-revived-trainer-firefox-vX.Y.Z.xpi`.
2. Open `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` → **Load Temporary Add-on…** → pick the file.
3. Needs Firefox 128+. Temporary add-ons disappear when Firefox closes.

### Safari (experimental)

Safari needs extensions wrapped in a macOS app. Download `u2-revived-trainer-safari-vX.Y.Z.zip` and follow the `README.txt` inside (it uses Xcode's `safari-web-extension-converter`). The game itself officially targets Chrome and Firefox, but it ran in Safari 27.2. So far that test covers the overlay, the online gate, the bank editor, Go Offline and Boost; the other car cheats haven't been run in Safari.

## How it works

The remake on nfsu2.xyz is the original PC game's code statically recompiled to WebAssembly. That has a neat side effect: **the game keeps its original 2004 memory layout**, so the addresses classic trainers used still point at the same things, just inside the page's WebAssembly memory instead of a Windows process.

- A content script runs in the page's own JavaScript world (`"world": "MAIN"`) and reads the game's shared `WebAssembly.Memory` directly.
- **Bank** lives at `0x861E74`.
- **Your car** is found through a pointer chain, `[[0x89CDA8] + 0x20] − 0x30`. From there: position `+0x50`, forward vector `+0x60`, linear velocity `+0xA0`, angular velocity `+0xB0`.
- **Nitrous** sits at `[0x89CCF8] + 0x454` and `+0x45C`.
- The overlay is a Shadow DOM panel. Its styles go through a constructable stylesheet because the site's Content Security Policy blocks inline `<style>`.

No network requests, no permissions beyond running on `nfsu2.xyz`, no data collected.

## Build from source

```bash
./scripts/build.sh
```

It creates `dist/` with one package per browser, plus `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The shared code lives in `src/trainer.js`, and each browser's manifest is in `platform/<browser>/`.

## Credits

- **Racer_S**: the original *NFSU2 +10 Trainer*. The key layout and memory offsets come from it.
- The **[Underground 2 Revived](https://nfsu2.xyz/)** team, for bringing the game to the browser.
- **[Archivo Narrow](https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/ArchivoNarrow)** by Omnibus-Type, the overlay's font ([SIL OFL 1.1](src/fonts-OFL.txt)).

## Disclaimer

A fan-made tool for personal, single-player fun. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Electronic Arts, the Need for Speed franchise, or the nfsu2.xyz project. All trademarks belong to their owners. If nfsu2.xyz updates its build, addresses may shift and the trainer may need an update.

`platform/safari/README.txt`:

```txt
U2 Revived Trainer — Safari build (EXPERIMENTAL, partly tested on Safari 27.2)

Safari can't load a web extension from a zip. It has to be wrapped in a
small macOS app with Xcode first:

  1. Unzip this folder somewhere you'll keep it, on a Mac with Xcode installed.
  2. In Terminal:
       xcrun safari-web-extension-converter /path/to/this/folder \
         --app-name "U2 Revived Trainer" --macos-only --no-open \
         --project-location /path/to/output-folder
     A warning about "world" is expected and can be ignored.
  3. Open the generated .xcodeproj, choose "Sign to Run Locally", and press Run.
     Leave the built app where it is.
  4. Safari > Settings > Advanced: turn on "Show features for web developers".
  5. Turn on "Allow Unsigned Extensions" (Developer tab of Settings, or the
     Develop menu). Safari may turn this off when it restarts.
  6. Safari > Settings > Extensions: tick U2 Revived Trainer, then allow it on
     nfsu2.xyz. "Edit Websites" stays grayed out until the box is ticked.
  7. Reload nfsu2.xyz, press Play, then press F2 (or Fn+F2) in the game.

On a MacBook: PgDn is Fn+Down, PgUp is Fn+Up, End is Fn+Right and Delete is
Fn+Delete. There's no Insert key, so click the Infinite Nitrous row in the panel.

Not yet tested in Safari: Instant 200, brakes, jump, move forward, nitrous, save
and warp, and Lock Speed. If something doesn't work, use Chrome or Firefox.

```

`scripts/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds release packages into dist/: one per browser.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
VERSION=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('platform/chromium/manifest.json'))['version'])")
rm -rf dist build && mkdir -p dist build
for target in chromium firefox safari; do
  out="build/$target"
  mkdir -p "$out/icons"
  cp src/trainer.js "$out/"
  cp platform/$target/manifest.json "$out/"
  cp icons/icon-{16,32,48,128}.png "$out/icons/"
  cp src/fonts-OFL.txt "$out/"
  [ -f "platform/$target/README.txt" ] && cp "platform/$target/README.txt" "$out/"
  (cd "$out" && zip -qr -X "../../dist/u2-revived-trainer-$target-v$VERSION.zip" .)
done
cp "dist/u2-revived-trainer-firefox-v$VERSION.zip" "dist/u2-revived-trainer-firefox-v$VERSION.xpi"
(cd dist && sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS.txt)
ls -l dist

```

`src/trainer.js`:

```js
// NFSU2 Revived Trainer — runs in the page (MAIN world) on nfsu2.xyz
// Addresses from Racer_S's "NFSU2 +10 Trainer"; the recompile keeps the original memory layout.
(() => {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__nfsTrainer) return;

  // ---------- known addresses ----------
  const CASH = 0x861E74;           // int32 bank
  const CAR_PTR = 0x89CDA8;        // car = [[CAR_PTR] + 0x20] - 0x30
  const NOS_PTR = 0x89CCF8;        // nitrous ints at [NOS_PTR] + 0x454 / + 0x45C
  const POS = 0x50, FWD = 0x60, VEL = 0xA0, ANG = 0xB0;
  const MPH200 = 89.408;           // m/s

  const LS = 'nfsTrainer.v2';
  const S = {
    offlineByUs: false, sessionRef: null,
    cashFreeze: false, cashFreezeVal: 0,
    nosInf: false, lockSpeed: false, lockKmh: 200,
    boostX: 2, maxKmh: 500, jump: 10, phaseM: 6,
    slots: {},
  };
  window.__nfsTrainer = S;
  let saved = {};
  try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS) || '{}'); } catch {}
  const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(LS, JSON.stringify(saved)); } catch {} };
  for (const k of ['lockKmh', 'boostX', 'maxKmh', 'jump', 'phaseM']) if (typeof saved[k] === 'number') S[k] = saved[k];

  // ---------- memory ----------
  let buf = null, dv = null;

  }
  const inRange = a => a > 0x10000 && a + 0x100 < buf.byteLength;
  const u32 = a => dv.getUint32(a, true), i32 = a => dv.getInt32(a, true);
  const f32 = a => dv.getFloat32(a, true);
  const wi32 = (a, v) => dv.setInt32(a, v, true), wf32 = (a, v) => dv.setFloat32(a, v, true);
  const vec = a => [f32(a), f32(a + 4), f32(a + 8)];
  const setVec = (a, v) => { wf32(a, v[0]); wf32(a + 4, v[1]); wf32(a + 8, v[2]); };
  const len = v => Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
  const money = v => '$' + Number(v).toLocaleString('en-US');

  function car() {
    if (!mem()) return 0;
    const p0 = u32(CAR_PTR); if (!inRange(p0)) return 0;
    const p1 = u32(p0 + 0x20); if (!inRange(p1)) return 0;
    const c = p1 - 0x30;

    instant: () => { const c = needCar(); if (!c) return; const f = vec(c + FWD); setVec(c + VEL, f.map(x => x * MPH200)); toast('200 MPH', 700); },
    brake: () => { const c = needCar(); if (!c) return; setVec(c + VEL, [0, 0, 0]); setVec(c + ANG, [0, 0, 0]); },
    jump: () => { const c = needCar(); if (!c) return; wf32(c + VEL + 8, f32(c + VEL + 8) + S.jump); },
    phase: () => { const c = needCar(); if (!c) return; const p = vec(c + POS), f = vec(c + FWD); setVec(c + POS, p.map((x, i) => x + f[i] * S.phaseM)); },

    nosShort: () => { if (!needCar()) return; const p = nos(); if (!p) return toast('Nitrous Not Found'); wi32(p + 0x454, 8000); wi32(p + 0x45C, 8000); toast('N2O Refilled', 800); },

  // Archivo Narrow Italic (SIL OFL 1.1, see fonts-OFL.txt), subset to Latin. The site's CSP (font-src 'self') blocks

  const FONTS = {
    500: '',
    700: '',
  };
  for (const [weight, data] of Object.entries(FONTS)) {
    try {
      new FontFace('U2 Trainer Narrow', Uint8Array.from(atob(data), c => c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer, { style: 'italic', weight })
        .load().then(f => document.fonts.add(f), () => {});

  root.innerHTML = `
<div class="p" id="p" hidden>
 <div class="hd"><span class="logo">U2 Trainer</span><span class="st" id="st"></span><button class="x" data-a="toggle" title="Hide (F2)">×</button></div>
 <div class="track"><i></i></div>
 <div class="bank"><span class="bl">Bank:</span><span class="big" id="cashNow"></span></div>
 <div class="row"><input id="cashVal" type="number" value="9999999"><button data-a="cashApply">Set Bank</button><label><input type="checkbox" id="cashFrz"> Freeze</label></div>
 <h3>Car · Offline Only</h3>
 <div class="row"><span id="netInfo" class="note"></span><button data-a="offline" id="offBtn">Go Offline</button></div>
 <div id="car">
  <div class="row"><span class="note" id="carInfo"></span></div>
  <div class="keys">
   <kbd>Y</kbd><span>Boost ×<input id="boostX" class="s" type="number" step="0.5"> Max <input id="maxKmh" class="s" type="number"> km/h</span>
   <kbd>I</kbd><span>Instant 200 MPH</span>
   <kbd>PgDn</kbd><span>Super Brakes</span>
   <kbd>End</kbd><span>Jump <input id="jump" class="s" type="number"></span>
   <kbd>PgUp</kbd><span>Move <input id="phaseM" class="s" type="number"> m Forward</span>
   <kbd>Ins</kbd><span class="act" data-a="nosToggle">Infinite Nitrous · Click or Press <span id="nosSt"></span></span>
   <kbd>Del</kbd><span>Nitrous Refill</span>
   <kbd>O</kbd><span>Bank $99,999,999</span>
   <kbd>Shift 1–9</kbd><span>Save Position</span>
   <kbd>Ctrl 1–9</kbd><span>Warp to Saved Position</span>
  </div>
  <div class="row mt"><label><input type="checkbox" id="lock"> Lock Speed at</label><input id="lockKmh" class="s" type="number"><span>km/h</span></div>
 </div>
 <div class="ft">F2 Show / Hide · Keys from Racer_S's Original +10 Trainer</div>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>`;
  const $ = id => root.getElementById(id);
  const panel = $('p');
  let toastT;
  function toast(msg, ms = 1600) { const t = $('toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('on'); clearTimeout(toastT); toastT = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('on'), ms); }

  for (const k of ['boostX', 'maxKmh', 'jump', 'phaseM', 'lockKmh']) $(k).value = S[k];
  root.addEventListener('click', e => { const a = e.target.closest('[data-a]')?.dataset.a; if (a) A[a]?.(); });
  root.addEventListener('change', e => {
    const id = e.target.id;
    if (id === 'cashFrz') { S.cashFreeze = e.target.checked; if (mem()) S.cashFreezeVal = i32(CASH); }

    else if (typeof S[id] === 'number') { const v = parseFloat(e.target.value); if (Number.isFinite(v)) { S[id] = v; saved[id] = v; save(); } }

  // build small status lines without innerHTML: 'text' | ['cls','text'] | [part, part...]
  function put(el, spec) {

      else if (x.length === 2 && typeof x[0] === 'string' && typeof x[1] === 'string' && /^(ok|bad)$/.test(x[0])) { const sp = document.createElement('span'); sp.className = x[0]; sp.textContent = x[1]; el.append(sp); }
      else x.forEach(add);
    };
    add(spec);
  }

  function render() {
    const attached = mem(), { n } = net(), ok = offlineOK();
    put($('st'), attached ? ['ok', 'Game Attached'] : ['bad', 'Waiting for Game']);
    $('cashNow').textContent = attached ? i32(CASH).toLocaleString('en-US') : '—';
    $('cashFrz').checked = S.cashFreeze;
    put($('netInfo'), !n ? 'Game Not Running'

    $('offBtn').hidden = !n || S.offlineByUs;
    $('car').className = ok ? '' : 'dis';
    const c = attached ? car() : 0;
    $('carInfo').textContent = c ? `Car Found · ${Math.round(len(vec(c + VEL)) * 3.6)} km/h` : 'Car Not Found (Menu or Loading?)';
    put($('nosSt'), S.nosInf ? ['ok', 'ON'] : '');
    $('lock').checked = S.lockSpeed;
  }

  // ---------- keys ----------
  const inPanel = e => e.composedPath().includes(host);
  const typing = () => { const a = document.activeElement; return a && (a.tagName === 'INPUT' || a.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || a.isContentEditable) || !!document.querySelector('dialog[open]'); };
  const swallow = e => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); };
  const keyMap = { KeyY: 'boost', KeyI: 'instant', PageDown: 'brake', End: 'jump', PageUp: 'phase', Insert: 'nosToggle', Delete: 'nosShort', KeyO: 'money' };
  const letterMap = { y: 'boost', i: 'instant', o: 'money' };
  // Latin layouts go by the letter typed (Y is elsewhere on QWERTZ); other alphabets go by key position.
  const actionFor = e => /^[a-z]$/i.test(e.key || '') ? letterMap[e.key.toLowerCase()] : keyMap[e.code];
  function onKey(e) {
    if (inPanel(e)) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); return; }
    if (e.code === 'F2') { if (e.type === 'keydown' && !e.repeat) A.toggle(); return swallow(e); }
    if (typing() || e.altKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const digit = /^Digit([1-9])$/.exec(e.code)?.[1];
    if (digit && (e.shiftKey || e.ctrlKey)) { if (e.type === 'keydown' && !e.repeat) (e.shiftKey ? A.savePos : A.warp)(digit); return swallow(e); }
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey) return;
    const a = actionFor(e);
    if (!a) return;
    if (a === 'money' ? !mem() : !offlineOK()) return;   // when cheats are off, let the key reach the game
    if (e.type === 'keydown' && !e.repeat) A[a]();

  }
  for (const t of ['keydown', 'keyup']) window.addEventListener(t, onKey, true);
  window.addEventListener('keypress', e => { if (inPanel(e)) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);
  for (const t of ['mousedown', 'mouseup', 'click', 'pointerdown', 'pointerup', 'wheel', 'contextmenu', 'touchstart', 'touchend'])
    host.addEventListener(t, e => e.stopPropagation());

  const mount = () => (document.fullscreenElement || document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(host);
  if (document.body) mount(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', mount, { once: true });
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', mount);
})();
